extension_gate: Freeze an extension only after all four initial matrices replay and the u=0 matrix is zero.
search_gate: Only nonzero classes in the certified restricted radical; first 15 by radical-coordinate weight. The u=0 known-point control needs no new point enumeration.
success_criterion: A deformation with a materially different obstruction profile and at least one exactly realized nonzero inherited class; a radical alone is insufficient.
claim_boundary: Realized dimension is a certified lower bound. No full Selmer group, global rank upper bound, or point-or-Sha decision from a bounded miss.
